articles.title: Ousted Ukraine defence chief becomes adviser to Italian minister
articles.summary: Mykhailo Fedorov, Ukraine's recently ousted defence minister whose sacking sparked wartime protests, has accepted a new advisory role to Italy's defence minister. This move signifies the shifting landscape of international defence personnel and inter-country cooperation, offering insights into European political and defence dynamics amidst the ongoing conflict.

articles.title: 4 Epic War Movies That Are More Historically Accurate Than You Think, Including A $480 Million Steven Spielberg Masterpiece
articles.summary: War has consistently been a major subject in cinema since its inception, with filmmakers frequently depicting armed conflicts. Directors return to this theme to explore its profound moral implications and its dramatic potential. This enduring cinematic focus reflects the medium's role in examining human conflict and its wide-ranging consequences through storytelling.

articles.title: The US stayed out of World War I for three years. Then a secret German telegram in 1917 changed everything
articles.summary: The United States initially maintained neutrality in World War I for nearly three years, with President Woodrow Wilson winning re-election in 1916 on a pledge to avoid the conflict. However, a series of events, notably unrestricted German submarine warfare and the Zimmermann Telegram, ultimately compelled the US to abandon its isolationist stance and declare war in April 1917, profoundly impacting the global conflict.

articles.title: Govt eases defence export rules, simplifies SOP and OGEL framework to boost global reach
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence has simplified its defence export standard operating procedures (SOPs) and open general licenses. This strategic move aims to dismantle policy barriers, significantly boosting the global reach of India's indigenous weapon systems. The simplification is expected to accelerate defence exports, promoting 'Make in India' and strengthening self-reliance in manufacturing.
